summary: John's 3rd cousin 8x removed (Bull → Daniel → Daniel 2d → Caleb → Caleb II); 1798 mill partner.
bio: Built a house in Hauppauge in 1790, reported to have stood at Veterans Highway and Old Willets Path, where the Suffolk County Police Fourth Precinct is today; moved to Commack in 1819; gave the Hauppauge house to daughter Sarah when she married Maj. Ebenezer Smith.
